name: Spark
source:
This is the story of Leez, a college student trying to keep her head above water in a world shaped by Sparkborne—people with unquestionable powers—while she’s still sowing her wild oats and figuring out who she really is.​

[From [url=https://frosty-free.itch.io/spark]Itch.io[/url]]
